question.text: A trader who expects the price of Reliance shares to fall should buy which type of option?

answer.text: Both call and put options on Reliance simultaneously

explanation.text: The Logic: A PUT option gives the right to SELL at the strike price. If the market price falls below the strike, the put buyer profits because they can sell at a higher price (strike) than the current market price. The Trap: Buying a call would be appropriate for a bullish (rising price) view, not bearish. Cross-Exam Context: Matching market view to option type is tested in application-based questions. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Bearish view = Buy Put. Bullish view = Buy Call.
